visualCharacteristics: White background, two-column article header. Left column is a large landscape image; right column holds a breadcrumb trail, heading and author/date/read-time metadata.
contentPattern: One row with two cells: an image cell and a text cell (breadcrumb + heading + meta). Image-only columns are auto-detected and ordered first on mobile.
usage: Article/case-study header pairing a hero image with title and byline metadata.
